description: This file defines classes for simulating user input events such as keyboard, mouse, and touchscreen actions within a browser automation framework. It includes methods for key presses, mouse movements, clicks, wheel scrolling, and touchscreen taps, utilizing an underlying channel for communication.

classes.name: Keyboard
classes.description: Represents keyboard input controls, allowing simulation of key presses, text insertion, and typing with options.

classes.name: Mouse
classes.description: Represents mouse input controls, allowing movement, clicking, double-clicking, and wheel actions.

classes.name: Touchscreen
classes.description: Represents touchscreen controls, specifically tap actions.

methods.name: Keyboard.up
methods.description: Releases a key that was pressed down.

methods.name: Keyboard.insertText
methods.description: Inserts text as if typed via the keyboard.

methods.name: Keyboard.type
methods.description: Types text with optional delay and speed controls.

methods.name: Keyboard.press
methods.description: Simulates pressing and releasing a key with optional modifiers.

methods.name: Mouse.move
methods.description: Moves the mouse to specified coordinates, with optional steps for smoothness.

methods.name: Mouse.click
methods.description: Performs a click at specified coordinates.

methods.name: Mouse.dblclick
methods.description: Performs a double click at specified coordinates, with options.

methods.name: Mouse.wheel
methods.description: Scrolls the wheel with specified delta values.

methods.name: Touchscreen.tap
methods.description: Simulates a tap gesture at specified coordinates.
